mainline: Current latent, action and state condition recurrent stochastic dynamics; predict the next latent while retaining updated memory.

components.label: Current context
components.visual_treatment: Native latent-vector, action and recurrent-state representations, explicitly distinguished as z at t, a at t and h at t. No invented observed pixel sample or toy numeric values.
components.construction_provenance: Official author MDN-RNN SVG and method text.

components.label: MDN-RNN
components.visual_treatment: Show actual LSTM recurrence and mixture-density head at meaningful internal depth. The Director chooses single-cell state loop or a compact truthful shared-weight unrolled motif. Mixture parameters are weights, means and standard deviations, not invented tokens. Preserve updated state as a separate object from predictive distribution. Temperature sampling may be internal for honest single-port grouping.
components.construction_provenance: Original author vector topology and public MDN-RNN equations.

components.label: Next-step prediction
components.visual_treatment: Show stochastic next latent versus updated recurrent state distinctly. If sampling is here, use a source-grounded internal state passthrough rather than making h flow through the sampler. Temperature controls uncertainty. Gaussian visualization only illustrative. No fictitious quantitative results.
components.construction_provenance: Official method: stochastic Gaussian-mixture prediction and temperature sampling.
